verdict.rationale: Proa renders server-side HTML and pure SVG, and hydrates islands with small vanilla-JS modules, so the browser receives real markup rather than a virtual-DOM abstraction. However, the docs never describe browser-devtools debugging, and they do not say whether island updates touch the real DOM directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how client-side island updates map to DOM nodes, any devtools debugging guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug my UI directly in browser devtools because the framework renders real DOM nodes

citations.quote: Proa emits the server-rendered HTML plus the JavaScript required for that island
Each hydrated RSJS island emits a small vanilla-JS module plus seed state
